title: Afghanistan school blast kills 10 students, injures more than 110 | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

At least 10 people have been killed and more than 110 injured after an explosion near a school in Afghanistan’s northeastern Kunar province, a Taliban spokesman says.

Preliminary investigations show that the blast happened at a storage depot holding explosives belonging to mining companies.

The deadly incident was the result of negligence and a lack of safety precautions, initial reports found, according to the spokesman.

Multiple videos from the scene show people desperately rushing injured children covered in blood to hospital using whatever means of transportation they can find.

A number of mining operations are located in Kunar province, which borders Pakistan.

It comes three months after an explosion at an education centre in Afghanistan’s capital city of Kabul injured at least 42 children. At least 35 of those admitted to hospital in the aftermath of that attack were aged between 10 and 15, Reuters reported.

This story has been updated.
